Technical SEO.title: Over 80% Of Google Searches Have AI Overviews & Growing
Technical SEO.summary: AI Overviews now appear in over 80% of Google searches, up from 50% in June of the prior year and roughly 15% the year before that, according to data from Semrush, SE Ranking, and seoClarity. The rapid expansion signals that AI-answer surfaces are now the dominant search experience rather than the exception.

Technical SEO.title: Google Adds Indexing Advice For Shareable Pages To Spam Guide
Technical SEO.summary: Google updated its spam guidance to advise that pages made purely for sharing should be blocked from crawling or marked noindex, while also noting that a URL blocked in robots.txt can still be indexed. Enterprise sites with large volumes of user-generated or shareable pages should audit their crawl and indexation directives against this new guidance.

Technical SEO.title: Google Warns Tools On User-Generated Spam Guidance & More
Technical SEO.summary: Google revised its user-generated spam help document to explicitly include platforms and tools that allow users to publish shared pages, generated content, or web apps. Sites running UGC features, review tools, or app-builder integrations should review whether their implementations fall under this expanded scope.

Technical SEO.title: Google Discover Tests Disabling Clicks In Sources Section
Technical SEO.summary: Google is reportedly testing a version of Discover cards where the sources button no longer opens a screen of linked source articles, potentially removing a key referral pathway for publishers. This is directly relevant to travel and content-heavy enterprise sites that rely on Discover as a traffic channel.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Generative UI Could Turn Google Into Your Booking.com
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece argues that Google evolving into a generative booking interface means brands must decide now whether to rely on Google completing transactions on their behalf or invest in owned channels. This framing is directly relevant to cruise and travel SEO teams weighing organic visibility against channel ownership.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Tactical Solutions For The Biggest AI Search Measurement Challenges
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: STAT's Tom Capper outlines approaches for measuring AI search impact beyond click data, including tracking brand presence, investigating citation sources, and improving attribution reporting. These methods are actionable for enterprise SEO teams trying to quantify GEO performance.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Google Gets The Thank-You
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The article distinguishes between referral attribution, which records who sent a visit, and the broader influence of what an AI model has learned prior to the session, arguing that GEO success is measured by what models internalize rather than what they retrieve at query time. This reframes how enterprise teams should think about brand presence in AI-answer surfaces.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: ChatGPT Rarely Named Some Brands Even When Sources Mentioned Them
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: New data from Graphite shows that brands appearing on pages cited by ChatGPT still received few or no direct brand mentions in AI responses, and brands with lower search visibility were also cited less even when their content was present on referenced pages. The finding has direct implications for enterprise brands optimizing for AI-answer inclusion.

AI Search / GEO.title: Rank Data Skews, AIOs Hit 97% of Buyer Queries: DesignRush SEO Roundup
AI Search / GEO.summary: The roundup reports that AI Overviews are now present on 97% of buyer-intent queries, a figure that underscores the urgency of optimizing for AI-answer surfaces in commercial verticals such as travel and automotive. It also flags that rank-tracking data may be skewed, which complicates performance measurement for enterprise SEO teams.

AI Search / GEO.title: October 2026 Google Webmaster Report: Spam Update, Gemini 3.8, AI Contribution & Monopoly Rulings
AI Search / GEO.summary: The monthly Google webmaster report covers the October spam update, the release of Gemini 3.8, developments in AI-generated content contribution to search, and ongoing monopoly ruling implications. Enterprise SEO managers should review the spam update and Gemini changes for potential ranking impact.

AI Search / GEO.title: Google Rankings Swing, ChatGPT Mislabels Traffic: DesignRush SEO Roundup
AI Search / GEO.summary: This roundup highlights observed Google ranking volatility alongside a finding that ChatGPT has been mislabeling or obscuring referral traffic in analytics, which directly affects how enterprise teams attribute and measure AI-driven visits. Both issues are operationally significant for enterprise SEO reporting.

AI Search / GEO.title: LLM Citation Study: 13,184 Citations Across 4 AI Tools
AI Search / GEO.summary: Orbit Media analyzed over 13,000 citations across ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and Google AI to identify which domains and content types are most frequently referenced by AI tools. The dataset provides a foundation for GEO strategy by showing what source characteristics correlate with citation selection.

AI Search / GEO.title: Optimizing Visibility in Generative Engines: A Critical Survey of Generative Engine Optimization (2023-2026)
AI Search / GEO.summary: This academic survey reviews GEO research from 2023 through 2026, synthesizing findings on how content signals influence visibility in generative search engines. It offers a research-grounded perspective that can inform enterprise GEO frameworks beyond practitioner opinion pieces.

AI Search / GEO.title: ChatGPT Ads With Learn More Arrow Link; Some Served Through Amazon DSP
AI Search / GEO.summary: OpenAI appears to be testing a new ChatGPT ad format featuring a dotted underlined learn-more link with an upward arrow, with some units reportedly served via Amazon DSP. Enterprise teams monitoring AI search commercialization and its effect on organic visibility should track this ad format rollout.
